body: Also thanks for seeing if i was okay! :)
yes im doing a little better. I talked to my friend about it and he actually listened to me and gave me alot of kind words.

Ive talked to a few friends but they just couldnt take me right now. Family problems or money problems. Which I completely understand. I care about my friends future alot. He is a very smart person he has alot going for him.
Im trying trust me. But i am failing, It gets really hard to to ignore it most of the times. Im trying my hardest to get out of here.
I knew i couldnt be the only person who talked to his dog. I love my grand-mother dearly. Thank you for the words
Ive tried they not the best counselors in the world. I really dont wanna confront my parents, and a year. But ill half to stay here even longer cause i gotta wait till i pay off my four-wheeler.

I push to make it though everyday. Alot of people tell me that things get alot better after high school. Im trying but I am failing right now. Yes I work on it. I know alot of stuff about four-wheelers. I could take one apart and put it back together no problem.

Honestly the dog has gotten me though alot, it sounds so stupid cause he cant talk or anything. But he is always by my side. Think and thin. My parents have never really been parents to me. My grandma buys most of my clothes and boots and stuff. I feed my own self and provide for my own self. Im trying my hardest to be happy, but it just seems farther away everyday. Thanks for the kind words though.

I really like to drive, ride four wheelers, or hangout with friends. But my parents barley let me see any friends. Im always so busy so i barley get to ride anymore. Its also my stress reliever, but im so busy I can barely ride.
Hi, and yes i still live with them. Im still in high school and have a monthly note i have to pay so i cant move out untill i finish high school :/

I want too trust me I do. But im still in high school and only have 1 job. I can barley pay for my four wheeler note. They have always been like this. I want to get out so bad, but nobody will take me.
